terminal.observation: An actual PTY child invoked applications.complaint_cli.main with chat --user-id pty-synthetic --max-turns 2, accepted Jordan Example and Acme Company, saved both answers, displayed the resume prompt and exited 0 within one second. Provider subprocesses and socket connects were blocked; session lived in a TemporaryDirectory.
CliRunner actual chat paused after two answers, resumed the remaining five with the same user ID, exited 0, and fresh ComplaintWorkspaceService read the persisted seven-answer completion.
run_intake_chat_turn(message="My landlord evicted me after my accommodation request.") records the initial complaint narrative as party_name.
Seven unknown answers produce conversation_state.is_complete=true and Intake complete. This is seven nonempty strings rather than resolved, answerable graph issues.
Completed workspace intake session has only annotation_knowledge_graph; run_intake_chat_turn does not invoke the factual KG/dependency-graph workflow.
CliRunner chat with empty input exits 1 with SystemExit instead of a documented pause outcome.
Synthetic workspace JSON persisted plaintext with mode 0664 under this environment umask. Encryption/private permissions require explicit implementation.

Legacy applications.cli.CLI uses Mediator.process, whose finalize raises UserPresentableException(not-implemented); CLI generic loop catches this and continues. scripts/run_cli_mediator.sh hardcodes llm-router-codex and expects root .venv absent in published worktree.

Reuse Mediator.start_three_phase_process and process_denoising_answer, ComplaintDenoiser candidate/answer APIs, and PhaseManager.get_intake_readiness. start_three_phase_process currently calls DependencyGraphBuilder.build_from_claims(claims) without legal_requirements; SummaryJudgmentHook.generate_requirements returns LLM-derived list[str], whereas graph builder expects structured requirement dictionaries.
PhaseManager.has_converged checks a five-loss plateau; ComplaintDenoiser.is_exhausted uses empty question pool or >50 asked. Neither alone establishes legal sufficiency.

graphs_law_logic.finding: Intake calls DependencyGraphBuilder.build_from_claims(claims) without legal_requirements. Actual statute graph is built only during formalization, so current initial questioning is not driven by retrieved verified legal requirements.

Statute requirement extraction is explicitly a placeholder using claim-type keywords; procedure builder uses simplified hardcoded federal requirements. Treat both as templates/candidates, not verified applicable law.
Missing/unrecognized state silently defaults to OR. Legal requirements must not be selected from a guessed jurisdiction; missing jurisdiction should remain unknown and trigger intake question.
Any corpus search hit currently classifies assertion as grounded. Retrieval is candidate evidence, not entailment, factual verification, applicability, or proof.

build_from_text marks all extracted entities/relationships source=complaint but does not attach source spans or provider receipts. Entity/Relationship provenance fields already exist and should carry user message identity/span/hash and extraction lineage.

is_exhausted treats more than 50 questions as exhaustion; question generation adds standard prompts and accumulates pool entries. Need stable question-target deduplication and distinct saturation, turn-cap, unknown/refused, deferred and unavailable dispositions.
Question exhaustion is ORed with phase convergence. A cap, failed backend or empty question list must not imply all answerable questions resolved.

Existing typed capability contract distinguishes implemented/degraded/unavailable; several legacy operations remain explicitly degraded despite provider imports. Preserve truthfulness while adding real canonical compiler/proof routing adapters.

Reusable first-party provenance/persistence/query contracts exist. Client persistence already uses actual upstream knowledge_graphs.Client. Current extraction helper primarily makes sentence facts; keep claim-element and law nodes separate from asserted factual facts.

Authority graph already supports treatment edges and source-bound rule candidates/governs edges; reuse rather than replace. Existing good-law-unconfirmed and adverse treatment must not be erased by retrieval relevance.

Local Boolean model lookups default missing predicates to false. Intake support reasoning must represent unknown separately from refutation and avoid closed-world rejection of missing complaint facts.
Several existing authority tests skip on missing imports/dependencies. Native supervisor completion must inspect JUnit required identities/skips, not only pytest exit code.

privacy_storage.finding: Lossy _slugify_user_id can map distinct identities onto same session filename.
Plaintext JSON sessions; corrupt/unreadable payload returns default state; fixed .tmp writer then os.replace lacks file/directory fsync or writer lock.
Shared plaintext local fallback; bafy prefix plus truncated SHA256 is synthetic identifier, not verified standard CID; marker file pin is local marker.
Explicit enable flag gates optional Kit constructor; high-level API construction can start node; CanonicalStorageService is protocol, not byte backend.
Plain theorem/report blobs; pin errors swallowed; sha256 fallback and bool(nonempty_report_cid) misreport pinned.
Actual reusable AES256GCM random salt/nonce PBKDF2 primitive; text only, no AAD.
KeyManager supports explicit KEYRING/MEMORY, FILE raw key storage; HSM/VAULT/TPM enum options not implemented.
EncryptionManager AES256GCM bytes+AAD branch reusable after qualification; avoid CBC and invalid16-byte nonce ChaCha branch.
Unsafe for private case defaults: machine-id/hostname-derived key with constant fallback; can downgrade AES to XOR.

SecureConfigManager has random Fernet generation/restrictive local master.key but stores raw (including password-derived) master key unwrapped and disables encryption when dependency absent; not private-user vault.
CredentialManager may fall back keyring->file; must not inherit silent fallback for user case key.
WALTransactionCoordinator has stable effects, fsynced decisions, crash injection and repeatable replay; caller must encrypt intent.
ReplicaReconciler bounded passes verifies readback digest/version and keeps deferred operations out of verified count.
IrohManifestStore offers cryptographically linked revisions, expected-head CAS and recover_head; owner-only permissions do not encrypt blobs.
Architecture-router prompt can create additional cloud egress beyond generation; privacy policy must precede routing.

scope: Read-only source inspection and synthetic offline terminal characterization. Known product defects are findings, not passing product acceptance. The synthetic router canary is a separate live provider observation.
